question: Pumping lowers the water table in an unconfined aquifer. Which statements can be correct?
success: Correct. Conductance includes flow geometry as well as hydraulic conductivity. Head-dependent saturated thickness can make conductance depend on the unknown head. Head dependence alone does not imply nonlinearity: a fixed linear head–flow relation remains linear.
failure: Conductance includes flow geometry as well as hydraulic conductivity. Head-dependent saturated thickness can make conductance depend on the unknown head. Head dependence alone does not imply nonlinearity: a fixed linear head–flow relation remains linear.

question: A steady-state model needs 30 numerical iterations. What does this tell you?
success: Correct. Iterations improve a numerical estimate; they do not advance physical time. Their number alone establishes neither convergence nor agreement with the real aquifer.
failure: Iterations improve a numerical estimate; they do not advance physical time. Their number alone establishes neither convergence nor agreement with the real aquifer.
